Section 4(b) terminates the Board 30 days after that submission; section 2(e) supplies only a deadline measured from the first meeting, with Presidential variation permitted. EO:13225 section 3 confirms prior termination, but supplies no date. Earliest cessation of the Board and dependent commands cannot be dated.

Section 2(a) separately directs the President to designate rivers from Committee recommendations. EO:13093 changes ten to up to20 without extending the Committee or abolishing the instruction. EO:13225 confirms completed work but supplies no actual designation/completion date. The held wording does not sufficiently resolve whether the finite Presidential instruction expires with Committee termination or ceases on actual performance. Its exact first cessation is therefore unestablished; later formal revocation cannot substitute for an earlier actual performance date.
